author: BrunoLobato
quote:
This game shouldn't even have the privilege of being called "GTA" because it has nothing to do with "Grand Theft". Never in any GTA storyline was there a situation where we had to progress in the story just to be able to steal a car. They stripped away the whole essence of "GTA"—there are no prostitutes, there are immortal NPCs, the game's physics are bad, and the driving physics in particular are terrible. When a plane crashes, it doesn't explode or do anything, it just falls. Since Rockstar wanted to show realism, this has nothing realistic about it. It feels more like a cheap boyfriend simulator, a grocery shopping simulator, and a fitness simulator.

I don't recommend it—it's no surprise to me, since a disappointment was already expected.

Dan Houser was the mastermind of GTA.
